limits: Temporary homes; no content is collected (the store gate is T003, redaction T004). Calendar validity of consentedAt (for example 2026-02-30) is checked by the validator only; the schema checks the YYYY-MM-DD shape. The per-run email salt itself is implemented with the redactor (T004).
outcome: passed: T002 part: traces.contentConsent accepts only none and redacted and defaults to none with a null consent record; a BL.0 profile without consentedAt and consentPreviewDigest reads as none. `lightning init --trace-consent redacted [--trace-sources ...]` previews level, consentedAt, sources (host-transcript only when listed, OD-1), retention, redaction classes (email as a per-run salted hash, OD-2), storage, residual risk and no expiry (OD-3); apply with the matching --preview-digest writes consentedAt and that digest. Unrelated changes keep the record, new sources renew it, lowering to none clears it, and `lightning status` shows level, consentedAt, sources and expires null. The schema and the validator agree on a valid and invalid corpus. Negative controls: raw, a record without consent, consent without a record, an answered record field, a stale or forged digest (nothing written), and plugin setup lab/off leave the profile byte-identical; the store refuses content without consent (store-consent).
